ValidationRule.description: VR-QUOTE-06: Block Quote leaving Draft if Account has credit block, pending Finance Approval, cumulative MRC/NRC exceeds limits, or Account has overdue 90+ days. Fires on Draft-to-non-Draft transition.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), 'Draft'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Draft')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Cancelled')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Rejected')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Void')), OR( Opportunity.Account.Credit_Block__c = TRUE, AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Opportunity.Account.Finance_Approval_Phase__c, 'Approved')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Opportunity.Account.Finance_Approval_Phase__c, 'Not_Required')), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Opportunity.Account.Finance_Approval_Phase__c))) ), AND( NOT(Credit_Finance_Approved__c), Opportunity.Account.Active_Quote_Count__c > 1, Opportunity.Account.Credit_Limit_MRC__c > 0, Opportunity.Account.Total_Active_Quoted_MRC__c > Opportunity.Account.Credit_Limit_MRC__c ), AND( NOT(Credit_Finance_Approved__c), Opportunity.Account.Active_Quote_Count__c > 1, Opportunity.Account.Credit_Limit_NRC__c > 0, Opportunity.Account.Total_Active_Quoted_NRC__c > Opportunity.Account.Credit_Limit_NRC__c ), Opportunity.Account.Overdue_90_Days__c > 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Quote cannot leave Draft. Possible reasons: Account Finance Approval incomplete, cumulative credit limit exceeded across active quotes, or Account has overdue balances beyond 90 days.
